name: doclap/newsletter-signup
title: Newsletter signup
description: A signup panel that saves the email on the visitor's own device, with consent and honest status messages.

newsletterText.default: Notes on design, motion and the details in between. A quieter space for ideas worth returning to.

consentLabel.default: I agree to save my email on this device for this signup preview.

disclosure.default: Prototype only. Your email stays in this browser; nothing is sent to a mailing service and no emails will be delivered.

savedStatus.default: Signup saved on this device only. You are not subscribed to a mailing list; no email has been sent.

restoredStatus.default: A signup is saved on this device. No mailing-list subscription has been created.

removedStatus.default: Saved signup removed from this device.

unavailableStatus.default: Local storage is unavailable. You can preview validation, but your signup cannot be saved.

saveFailedStatus.default: Your signup could not be saved. Allow browser storage and try again; nothing has been sent.

removeFailedStatus.default: The saved signup could not be removed. Please clear this site’s data in your browser settings.
